Every listed mod is in a folder
Moves the ticked mods in the list into their suggested folders.
Closes the window without moving any mod.
Pick a folder to review only its suggestions. APPLY then moves only the ticked mods listed.
Suggests a folder for each mod without one, for every folder or just one. The guesses are rough, and nothing moves until you apply.
These are rough guesses from each mod's categories, name, id, description and requirements. Check them before you apply.
Suggest folders for %1 mods? The suggestions are rough guesses, so check them before you apply.
Orders the suggestions in the list.
Made for B41 only. B42 does not load it.
Back to the list of the mod's files.
Sort the %1 listed mods without a folder, one at a time?
Goes through the listed mods without a folder, one at a time.
Makes a new folder for this mod.
This kind of file is not shown here. Show In Folder opens its folder.
Folds every folder, No Folder included.
Lists only the mods of the chosen collection.
Copies your folders, their icons and which mods are in them as text, to share or keep.
Copies your mods as Mods, WorkshopItems and Map lines for a server ini.
Delete the folder %1? Its mods go back to No Folder.
Disable the %1 mods in %2? Mods that need them are disabled too.
Disable the %1 mods on the list? Mods that need them are disabled too.
Disables every mod the list shows now, and the mods that need them.
Enable the %1 mods on the list?
Enables every mod the list shows now.
Opens every folder, No Folder included.
Shows only the files whose path has this text.
Click to fold, drag to move. The box turns every listed mod in it on or off.
Copied %1 folders. Paste the text anywhere to share it.
%1 mods running now are not on this server's mod list: %2. Host anyway?
Start with # to search mod descriptions.
Installed in more than one place: <LINE> %1
Needs mods that are missing or disabled: %1
No suggestions for the mods without a folder
This save has no mod list
Not a collection, or it is empty
The clipboard holds no folders for mods you have
Click to open the mod's Workshop page.
Replace the settings of %1 with the copied ones?
Add %1 folders and put %2 of your mods in them? Mods already in a folder move to the pasted one.
Adds folders copied with Copy Folders. Only mods you have go into them, and your other folders stay.
Read the chosen collection again and subscribe to anything new
Remove the collection %1 from the list?
Remove the chosen collection from the list
Delete every folder? The mods stay enabled or disabled as they are.
Deletes every folder. The mods stay as they are, and Undo Changes brings the folders back.
Replace the preset %1 with the mods ticked now?
Replaces every mod setting with a saved backup. The current settings are backed up first.
Replace every mod setting with the backup from %1?
Put every mod back the way it was when the list opened?
Puts every mod and folder back the way it was when the list opened.
Start with # to search inside text fields.
Start with # to search inside text fields, or with @ to search mod names.
Start with @ to search mod names.
Opens the folder that holds this file in your file browser. The file itself is never run.
Picks which mods the list shows.
Leaves this mod without a folder and shows the next one.
Steam did not take the request
Closes the window. Folders picked so far stay.
Subscribes to every Workshop item your installed mods require and you do not have.
Subscribing to %1 items. They show up once Steam downloads them.
Saves the ticked mods and reloads the game's Lua.
Adds a preset from text someone shared.
Leaves the mod list. With unaccepted changes it asks whether to keep them.
Closes the list without changing the category.
Disables the mod and the mods listed here.
Keeps every mod as it is.
Turns this mod on or off.
Marks this mod as a favourite. Favourites sort first.
Shows only the mods of one category or filter.
Hides this mod from the list, or shows it again.
Ticks the mods of the chosen preset.
Sets which map loads first where maps overlap.
Opens the load order of the ticked mods.
Searches mod names, ids, authors and requirements.
Picks a preset and ticks its mods. Also enables or disables everything.
Opens the load order of the chosen preset.
Searches the mods of the chosen preset.
Opens the Presets window: presets, their load order and your recent mod lists.
Reloads the game's Lua without saving the mod list.
Saves the ticked mods as a preset.
Saves the changes and closes the settings.
Saves the changes and keeps the settings open.
Closes the settings. Changes not applied are dropped.
Searches page names and option names.
Changes the order of the page list.
Shows the chosen preset as text to share.
Shows the ticked mods as text to share.
Changes the order of the mod list.
Sorts the load order with Mod Load Order Sorter, then saves like ACCEPT.
Opens a panel with actions for the whole list.
Unsubscribe from this Workshop item. Its mods are disabled now and deleted by Steam when the game closes.

A new server starts with the mods you have on, in load order, with their Workshop items, maps and spawn regions, and skips the Choose Mods step. Change them later on the Mods page. Off starts it empty.
Lists installed mods made only for B41, which the game leaves out because B42 cannot load them, and adds a B41 Mods filter. Off leaves them out.
Adds Steam collections to TOOLS: add one by link or id to subscribe to its items, and pick one to list only its mods.
Hovering the + and - numbers at the top lists the mods ticked or unticked since the list opened.
Renames the DEL button under the mod list to DELETE.
Adds a row listing the mods that need this one. Click a name to jump to it.
Starting a search with # looks for the words in mod descriptions instead of names.
Draws only the rows on screen. Mod Manager draws every row of the list every frame, which slows scrolling with many mods.
Stops Mod Manager rereading its data and every mod.info each time the mod list opens, and building the mod settings screen three times. Off restores Mod Manager's own behaviour.
Adds Java mods, updated since last visit, missing requirements and installed twice to the filter list.
Shows mod posters and icons saved in a format the game cannot read, instead of an error. Off leaves them blank.
Reads a mod's sandbox options past comment lines and mistakes that make the game drop the rest of the file. Off reads them the game's way.
Adds BULK FOLDER and AUTO FOLDER buttons above the mod list.
Drag a mod, or the selected mods, onto a folder's header to put them in it, or onto No Folder to take them out. Drag a folder's header to move the folder. Off keeps the list still under the mouse.
Groups the mod list into folders, sorted by name. Click a folder to fold it, tick its box to turn all its listed mods on or off, and right-click it for more.
Removes the author name from each row of the mod list. The mod info panel still shows it.
Tints the mods updated on the Workshop since the mod list was last opened.
Names each History entry after the preset it matches, or the closest one and how many mods differ. The date moves to the right. Off shows only the date.
Before hosting, warns when mods running now are missing from the server's mod list.
Hides the empty screenshot strip, writes None in empty rows and a note when there is no description or change notes, and dims the row names. Off keeps Mod Manager's panel.
For mods with Java code, shows the jar and whether ZombieBuddy loaded it.
Loading a save drops the mods and maps that are not installed from its mod list. This puts them back, so the save still asks for them.
Keeps mods that are no longer installed ticked, so they load again once reinstalled. Turn it off and accept to clear them.
Shows the description and the change notes in the larger font. Off keeps the small one.
With the mouse over the mod list, typing a letter jumps to the next mod starting with it. Ctrl+F puts the cursor in the search box.
Shows each mod's poster.png in the mod list instead of its icon.png. A mod without a poster keeps its icon.
Shows each enabled mod's place in the load order next to the author, as #12.
Shows a bar on the save loading screen with what is loading, how far along it is and which mod it comes from. Off keeps the game's loading screen.
Marks enabled mods with a missing or disabled requirement, and mods installed in more than one place. Hover the row to see which.

Ctrl+Click adds or removes a mod from the selection, Shift+Click selects every mod between two clicks and Ctrl+A selects every listed mod. Right-click a selected mod to hide, enable, disable or file them all at once. Off keeps one mod selected at a time.
Lists mods made for a different game version. Off hides them, except the ones still turned on. Also in TOOLS.
Right-click a page to rename it, hide it, or copy and paste its settings.
Pages whose mod has no poster.png show the ModTemplate poster. Off leaves the spot empty.
Shows the poster of the mod each page belongs to, next to its name.
Right-click a preset or History entry to compare its mods with your current selection, another preset, a History entry or a save.
Drag presets in the Presets window into a custom order, and the preset list under the mod list follows it. Off sorts them by name.
Right-click the preset list to sort it by your own order, name, date saved or mod count. Off keeps Mod Manager's order.
Right-click a preset to rename or duplicate it, or a history entry to save it as a preset. Saving over a preset needs a confirmation, and the Presets window shows what loading a preset changes.
Leaving the mod list or the server settings only reloads Lua when the mods that can load have changed. Off reloads whenever the list differs at all.
Shows a black screen while Lua reloads, with a bar, what is loading and from which mod. Off keeps the game's small Reloading Lua label.
Opens the mod list with the sort you picked last time, even after a restart. Off always starts sorted by name.
Opens the mod settings screen on the page where you last changed a value.
Fixes two game bugs that wipe mod settings: the game glues the settings of unloaded mods onto one line, and loads empty text fields as missing. It also splits lines the game already glued together.
Right-click a mod to hide it, put it in a folder, open its Workshop page or copy its ids.
Draws the page names and posters bigger. Off keeps the game's size.
With the mouse over the page list, typing a letter jumps to the next page starting with it. Ctrl+F puts the cursor in the search box.
Starting a search with @ looks for the name of the mod each page belongs to. The game's own pages answer to Project Zomboid.
Right-click a page to rename it, hide it, or copy and paste its settings.
Shows the poster of the mod each page belongs to, next to its name.
Opens the sandbox settings on the page where you last changed a value before starting a game.
Scrolls the page to the first option that matches the search.
Adds a sort list next to the search box of the sandbox settings: Default Order, Name, Last Updated and Last Changed. Off keeps the game's page order.
Starting a search with # looks for the words inside text boxes instead of option names.
Makes the in-game Sandbox Options window of the admin panel and debug menu taller, centred and easier to read, with boxes wide enough for their choices. Off keeps the game's window.
Saving a server puts its Workshop items, maps and spawn regions in load order and map order. Spawn regions you added by hand keep their place. Off saves them as listed.
Scrolls the page to the first option that matches the search.
Search boxes show a magnifier and "Type to search..." while empty. Off shows the plain boxes.
Draws the page names and posters bigger, with a wider page list. Off keeps the game's size.
Names the page groups Server and Sandbox, shows how many pages each has, and folds a group when its header is clicked. Off keeps the game's INI and Sandbox headers.

Fits the server list and the host screen's server box to the longest name, centres each settings page with boxes wide enough for their choices, and widens the Choose Mods list. Off keeps the game's layout.
With the mouse over the page list, typing a letter jumps to the next page starting with it. Ctrl+F puts the cursor in the search box.
Starting a search with @ looks for the name of the mod each page belongs to. The game's own pages answer to Project Zomboid.
Right-click a page to rename it, hide it, or copy and paste its settings.
Shows the poster of the mod each sandbox page belongs to, next to its name.
Opens the server settings on the page where you last changed a value before saving.
Scrolls the page to the first option that matches the search.
Adds a sort list next to the search box of the server settings: Default Order, Name, Last Updated and Last Changed. Off keeps the game's page order.
Starting a search with # looks for the words inside text boxes instead of option names.
Keeps the last 10 versions of the mod settings file and saves a new one each time a setting changes.
Draws the page names and posters bigger, with a wider page list. Off keeps Mod Manager's size.
Renames the CONFIGS button and the MOD OPTIONS header to MOD SETTINGS.
With the mouse over the page list, typing a letter jumps to the next page starting with it. Ctrl+F puts the cursor in the search box.
Starting a search with @ looks for the name of the mod each page belongs to.
Adds Last Updated and Last Changed to the sort list of the mod settings screen.
Adds a Files tab next to the mod info, listing every file of the selected mod.
Shows how long ago each Workshop mod was updated, next to the author. Local mods have no date.
Adds Size to the sort list, largest Workshop download first, and shows each size while sorting by it.
Disable All, in the preset list and in TOOLS, leaves Mod Manager Extension, Mod Load Order Sorter Extension and the mods they need enabled. Off disables them too.
Shades every other mod in the list, so a long list is easier to follow across. Off draws every row alike.

Adds a TOOLS button next to MOD SETTINGS with the Show Enabled/Disabled/Hidden tickboxes, enabling or disabling every listed mod, undoing this visit's changes, copying your mods for a server, and folding, removing, copying or pasting folders.
Adds tooltips to Mod Manager's own buttons, lists and boxes. Off leaves them without.
Starting a search with # looks for the words inside text fields instead of option names.
Adds a red UNSUBSCRIBE button next to Enable, Subscribe To Requirements to the right-click menu, and Subscribe To All Requirements to TOOLS.
